[0-2s] Vertical 9:16. 100mm macro, camera at the Yorkshire terrier's eye height, 15 degrees off the nose, aperture f/2. Extreme close-up of a tiny Yorkshire terrier: tan wet facial hair clumped into separate strands, dark round eyes with one window catchlight, black nose with a single water bead. Steel-blue body fur is only a soft edge of frame. Large north-window key light from camera left, soft shadow under the muzzle, no flash. Sound: one dry scissor snip, then quiet. No dialogue.
[2-6s] Cut. 35mm lens. The camera starts at the table surface and slowly dollies back while rising to a three-quarter front angle. A small white poodle with tight curls rests in thick foam on a pale gray grooming table; individual bubbles catch the window. Only the groomer's forearms show: warm skin, short clean nails, a turquoise cotton apron #0C6E78. The poodle's eyes are closed. A soft contact shadow of the body falls on the table. The background falls out of focus: a light gray wall #E6E5E1. Sound: soft water and foam. No music. No dialogue.
[6-11s] Cut. 24mm lens locked at the animals' eye line, about 40 centimeters off the floor, slow 10-centimeter push-in. Six animals stand packed tight on the light gray floor and turn their heads toward the lens in the same half-second. Left to right: the same tiny tan-faced Yorkshire terrier; the same white curly poodle, now rinsed; a cream Pomeranian with a fox muzzle and a thick standing coat; a Maltese with long straight white hair and a round head, not curly; a gray tabby domestic shorthair cat sitting, ears up, one slow blink; a powder-white Bichon Frise with loose curls, a round skull, dark eyes, a dark nose, no collar and no tag. Little space between the faces. All eyes on the viewer. Window light from the left, fill only from the gray wall, a contact shadow under every paw. Behind them, huge warm-black letters #1A1814 spelling OXIGROOM are cropped by the left and right frame edges and slightly soft, because focus sits on the eyes. Sound: one low warm hit, then room tone. No dialogue.
[11-15s] Cut. 50mm lens. The white Bichon sits in the foreground, tilts its head to its left, and lifts one front paw. The other animals stay in soft focus behind. The camera then pushes into the Yorkshire terrier's wet eyes until the frame matches the opening shot. Same window light, same contact shadow under the raised paw. Sound: the same single scissor snip returns. No dialogue.
Photographed on a full-frame camera, 24fps, natural sensor grain, micro-detail in wet fur, foam, and ear twitches. Lived-in grooming studio. No CGI, no plastic fur, no beauty filter.
No stethoscope. No veterinary clinic. No pet-shop shelves. No price tags. No cages. No cartoon. No extra limbs. No turtle, parrot, or hamster. No lyrics. No extra sound effects. No subtitles. The only readable text is the cropped wall word OXIGROOM.
